label: Estimated incident TB cases
definition: WHO-derived estimate of people who developed TB during the year.

label: TB incidence rate
definition: Estimated incident TB cases per 100,000 population.

label: Notified new and relapse cases
definition: New and relapse TB cases officially notified to national programmes.

label: Case notification rate
definition: Notified new and relapse cases per 100,000 population.

label: Case detection / diagnosis and treatment coverage
definition: Notified new and relapse cases divided by estimated incident cases.

label: Coverage gap
definition: 100 minus calculated diagnosis and treatment coverage.

label: Estimated notification difference
definition: Estimated incident cases minus notified cases; it is not proof that every person in the difference was untreated.

label: Estimated TB deaths
definition: Estimated deaths from TB, including HIV-associated TB deaths where included in the source measure.

label: Case fatality ratio
definition: Estimated TB deaths divided by estimated incident TB cases.

label: HIV-associated incident TB
definition: Estimated incident TB cases among people living with HIV.

label: TB deaths among people with HIV
definition: Estimated TB deaths among people living with HIV.

label: HIV-associated share of incident TB
definition: Estimated HIV-associated incident TB divided by all incident TB.

label: Estimated RR/MDR-TB incidence
definition: Estimated incident rifampicin-resistant or multidrug-resistant TB cases.

label: RR/MDR-TB share of incident TB
definition: Estimated RR/MDR-TB incidence divided by all incident TB.

label: Population
definition: Population denominator used for rate calculation.

label: Age group
definition: Age category used in the 2024 age-sex incidence estimate.

label: Sex
definition: All sexes, female or male in the source age-sex estimate.
